bio: Malmaison Birmingham is a stylish boutique hotel housed within Mailbox, the former Royal Mail building at the heart of the city centre, right next to Birmingham New Street station.  Malmaison have re-imagined the classic Afternoon Tea menu. Savouries include a beef slider on brioche bun, Cumberland sausage & apple roll and prawn cocktail. Sweet treats include Calamansi citrus meringue tart, dark chocolate & salted caramel tart and raspberry ripple & white chocolate sundae.  Special dietary requirements are catered for, with alternative menus for vegetarians/vegans and for those with gluten and nut allergies. Pre-booking is required. Please specify dietary needs using the 'Special Request' field.  All Afternoon Tea menus are served with a choice of teas and infusions, including English breakfast, Earl Grey and Green tea with jasmine.  Afternoon Tea is served Monday to Thursday 12pm to 2pm, Friday 12pm to 3pm, Saturday 12.30pm to 4pm and Sunday 1pm to 4pm, and costs £29.50 per person.
